nonblocking_findings.description: visualizationLearnerStateUnion.test.ts behavioral test (line 37) times out after 5000ms. The test dynamically imports '@/convex/student' inside the test body, which triggers loadFullCurriculumGraph() and parses 574-node JSON. The timeout is a test reliability concern, not a contract violation. The two source-lint assertions in the same file pass. Recommendation: increase the test timeout or move the dynamic import to module scope.

ParentDashboard.tsx contains switch cases for 'review_due' (stateLabel line 126, stateBadgeClass line 143) and RecommendedNextPanel.tsx declares 'review_due' in its RecommendedNextItem.state union (line 7). These are correct: the UI consumes VisualNodeV1 from the shared schema which still includes 'review_due'. The handler-local narrowing is invisible to UI types. No type errors result. The cases are dead code from the IM3 handler perspective but required for schema compatibility.

ParentDashboard.tsx JSDoc at line 56 still references 'module-1 knowledge graph'. This is stale wording from before FR-4. The handler now loads the full multi-module graph via loadFullCurriculumGraph(). Not a violation — documentation drift only.
